reason: Logic checks out (sky_H is 23-28 at every sky_geom entry: type_ok from sky_heights, sky_old_geom from sky_h stored from sky_H; n >= 15 so the peeled first test is always taken; C is 1 into every SBC; same RAM in render_bss, same ROMSEL/HAZEL state; peeled entry saves about 21 cycles plus 2 per further loop pass). But it grows hazel_b by 32 bytes (+33 added, -1 SEC) and does not fit the region on the gameplay disc: on branch gameplay-shield (main plus the GAMEPLAY_*/HUD_RUPTURE flags, which must take main's changes) decision 67 puts level_movers_x_low, ground_columns and rup_k_lo/hi straight after sky_hazel.6502 in hazel_b, and build/strykers-gameplay.lst (built 2026-10-23 01:23 with HUD_RUPTURE=1) has sky_col_check ending at &DF65 and hazel_b_end = &DFFF with no SKIP in between: 1 byte free under the &E000 ASSERT. With this candidate hazel_b_end would be about &E01F ('HAZEL overruns by 31'), and ground_columns' page rule could add more. The 123 bytes the claim counts exist only on the plain disc; HAZEL is effectively full for the gameplay disc, so a 32-byte growth for ~20 cycles a pass breaks the project's other shipping build.
